JoSAA Counselling Round 2 Allotment Results Expected Today

The Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA) is expected to release the Round 2 allotment results for counselling today. Students awaiting their seat assignments can check the results online. This is a crucial step for candidates seeking admission to engineering and architecture programs in IITs, NITs, and other centrally funded technical institutions.
